name: comp-409
title: Avatar Group Overflow
blurb: Avatar group with overflow indicator showing additional hidden avatars.
description: Renders four circular avatars at 40px size with negative margins, plus a secondary-colored button showing "+3" to indicate more avatars are hidden. Uses a Button component with hover effects.
use_when: When displaying multiple avatars but limited space, showing a count of hidden team members or social proof at a glance.
avoid_when: When all avatars fit on screen, or when the count of hidden avatars is unknown or dynamic.
a11y: Avatar images have alt text. The overflow button is a Button component so it is keyboard accessible and has semantic focus handling.
